integrity: The result is an original mathematical argument presented without independent mathematical certification or guaranteed historical priority. The standalone checker has no third-party dependencies.
scientific_limitations: The cardinality polynomial and minimum seed comparison are proved for crown graphs Cr_n with n>=4 and three named colours only; the n=3 cycle is excluded. The argument is a proof by classification and constructive forcing, supplemented but not replaced by exhaustive finite verification for n=4 and 5. Other palette sizes and general bipartite matching deletions are unproved. Priority remains qualified until independent full-literature review.
title: Exact three-colour forcing enumerator for crown graphs
